🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 26, 2026

Moon, at home in Cancer, holds a sextile to Mars, in Virgo. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Virgo. Moon squares you from Cancer, and the cost objects. Fire opens the file, and the file has a price. Since Mars crossed out of Leo, the question has changed.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra and answers to nobody. Moon sextiles you from Cancer: a door left ajar. Earth keeps what it has, cheaply. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you from Scorpio on plain terms, without privilege. From Virgo, Mars cuts across the appetite. Mutable air: every option kept is an option paid for. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from its own Cancer. From Virgo, Mars offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Water that starts things, started cheaply. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, crosses Sagittarius untitled. From Scorpio, Mercury sets a figure against the wanting. Fire that holds on, charged for holding. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Scorpio: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon in Cancer makes room for you, and then waits. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. Forward again for two weeks now, Mercury has left the old ground.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you from Libra, a sign it owns outright. Moon squares you from Cancer, and something has to give way. Cardinal air meets a bill. Two weeks ago Venus was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you from Virgo, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. Moon trines you from Cancer, meeting no resistance. Fixed water: nothing needs letting go of today. Moon let go of it two weeks ago.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Mars in Virgo presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Fire that changes shape, charged for each shape. It has held four weeks without changing its terms.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. From Cancer, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Earth moves first and pays first. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Sagittarius: an opening to be reached for. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Saturn has covered 1° since early November, quietly.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Moon in Cancer sides with you before you have argued. Water bends, and bending costs nothing here. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.
